capabilities: record audio directly into a note with pause, resume, and restart controls
transcribe imported or recorded audio files using AI models
generate Markdown notes from transcripts via a customizable prompt
choose which vault folder stores recorded audio files
toggle whether the raw transcript is included in the generated notes
extras: Audio is sent to OpenAI's online models for transcription (text retained up to 30 days, audio not retained); local model transcription is planned. Obsidian's native recorder must be turned off for this plugin's recording to work. Smart Templates integration with Smart Connections is announced as coming soon.
motivation: The author wants valuable information from audio sources to not get lost and to be integrated into the user's own note-taking, especially for users who prefer speaking over writing.
problem: Obsidian can record audio into notes but cannot transcribe recordings or turn spoken audio into written notes and analysis.

relations.evidence: I'm working with Brian (creator of smart connections) to integrate "Smart Templates"

summary: Voice memo plugin that records or imports audio, transcribes it with OpenAI models, and generates customizable Markdown notes from the transcript.
